title: Release of a temporary array
summary: Proves that calling the runtime release on an owned array without child pointers frees its block, and that the allocator invariant holds afterward with the block at the head of the free list.
premises: The module has no imports and release at function 1
The source local holds the array's pointer
Heap.At for the store and Heap.Owned for the array; the frame lemmas take its Heap.Object
result: The state is unchanged and the store is heap.releaseStore; Heap.At.release gives the invariant for heap.release, and releaseStore_bytes keeps every byte outside the array's header.
